domains.name: De Novo Genome Assembly and Polishing
domains.scope: Construct, polish, phase, validate, and release reference-quality genome assemblies from heterogeneous sequencing inputs.

domains.name: Pangenome Construction and Graph Genomics
domains.scope: Build, validate, annotate, query, and release population-scale sequence graphs representing diverse haplotypes.

domains.name: Germline Small-Variant Discovery
domains.scope: Detect, genotype, normalize, filter, annotate, and release inherited SNVs and small indels from sequencing cohorts.

domains.name: Somatic Variant and Tumour Evolution Analysis
domains.scope: Detect tumour-specific variation, control artefacts, estimate clonality, and reconstruct spatial or longitudinal tumour evolution.

domains.name: Structural Variant and Copy-Number Analysis
domains.scope: Detect, reconcile, genotype, annotate, and report structural variants and copy-number alterations across assays and cohorts.

domains.name: Repeat Expansion and Mobile-Element Genomics
domains.scope: Detect tandem-repeat expansions, repeat instability, mobile-element insertions, and transposable-element activity from genomic data.

domains.name: Genome Annotation and Functional Element Mapping
domains.scope: Annotate genes, transcripts, non-coding RNAs, repeats, and regulatory elements on new or revised genome assemblies.

domains.name: Population Genomics and Genome-Wide Association Studies
domains.scope: Perform cohort QC, population-structure analysis, association testing, fine-mapping, heritability estimation, and polygenic modelling.

domains.name: Rare-Disease Genomic Diagnosis
domains.scope: Prioritize candidate genomic causes of rare disease using phenotype, pedigree, inheritance, variant, and gene-disease evidence.

domains.name: Clinical Variant Interpretation and Reporting
domains.scope: Evaluate variant pathogenicity with transparent evidence, standardized nomenclature, controlled classification logic, and qualified review.

safety_boundary: This phase defines computational and evidence-management task nodes only. It does not authorize autonomous wet-lab operations or unreviewed clinical decisions.
